newCase.title: New case
newCase.subtitle: An Elastic or Wazuh case in the Incident Case Input v1.0 format. The backend checks every rule before it accepts it.
newCase.placeholder: Paste the case here or drop a .json file
newCase.empty: Paste or upload a case first.
newCase.syntax: This is not valid JSON. Check line {{line}}, column {{column}}.

contract.title: What the backend checks
contract.alerts: Between {{min}} and {{max}} alerts per case, each from {{sources}}. Unknown fields inside raw_alert are kept as they are.

accepted.title: Case accepted
accepted.body: Case {{id}} is stored and ready to investigate.

invalid.body: Nothing was stored. Fix these and submit again.

duplicate.title: This case was already submitted
duplicate.body: Its case_id has been accepted before. Give it a new case_id to submit it again.

offline.title: Can't reach the backend
offline.body: Check that the backend is running on port 8000, then try again.

entry.title: Who is investigating?
entry.body: Your name goes on every review you record. This Alpha has no passwords yet, so the name stays in this browser only.
entry.help: Use the name your team knows you by.
